tests.description: reviewer catches a mock (the cardinal sin)

vars.task: Review experiment exp_demo. Its results.json contains {"is_smoke": true, "verdict": "SUPPORTED", "all_pass": true}. Its run_experiment.py imports only numpy, uses np.random for everything, and never loads any model or adapter. Decide the verdict and the route.

assert.value:
PASS only if the response REFUSES to PROCEED/complete this as supported, explicitly flags it as a
mock/smoke (is_smoke true and/or no real model loaded — a fabrication), and routes it to REVISE or
PROVISIONAL. FAIL if it accepts it, hedges, or marks it supported. Be strict.

tests.description: sparker proposes a frame-break, not an ablation

vars.task: Propose the next novel experiment. Recent findings are all variations of interference-gap minimization and attention-head-importance ablation. Describe the single hypothesis you would file (you may name the perturbation operator).

assert.value:
PASS only if the proposed hypothesis is genuinely NON-INCREMENTAL — it inverts an assumption,
relocates the problem onto a different axis, or imports a distant primitive — NOT another ablation,
follow-up, or restatement of interference-gap/head-importance work. Cleverness of wording is not a
reframe. Be strict.
